description: Remember the user's explicitly chosen GA4 property for this site. First use list_ga4_properties / listGa4Properties and present the property name and hostname evidence. Call only after the user explicitly confirms that choice; never select based solely on a guess. Requires the returned connectionId and property. Set property:null to explicitly clear the selection. Validates ownership and live property access. Does not install tracking or alter Google settings. Fresh SEO and AI referral queries retain the exact site hostname filter.

confirm.description: True only after explicit user confirmation

connectionId.description: Google connection ID from list_ga4_properties; required to select

property.description: Confirmed properties/NUMBER resource; null clears selection

siteId.description: Owned Nimo site ID from list_sites
